sam_sales: FYI - CarePrint is verbally onboard for a 24mo commit. Their app mixes high-concurrency chat sessions and nightly bulk embeddings. They need firm 99p latency targets, predictable monthly spend, and preheat guarantees. How do we size reserved vs burst?
jade_eng: Congrats. Need the traffic curve: peak qps window, baseline qps, token distribution, and embedding batch sizes. Also whether single-region only.
sam_sales: Single-region required. Peak: ~520 rps at 11:00-11:20, baseline 70 rps. Mix: 60% chat (median 160 tokens, 95p 1100, 99p 1900), 40% embeddings (batch ~20). 99p target 2s. Customer wants cost ~30% under standard hosted.
mina_ml: Long tails mean KV caching is vital. Suggest separate embedding pool and chat reserved pool. Quantized fallbacks help cost but must be quality-checked.
omar_sre: Operationally: reserved baseline covering ~65-75% of expected peak, burst pool for 2x daily surge, and scheduled preheat 15-25min before peak. Recommend per-AZ reserved spread if they insist on single-region SLA.
tara_security: PHI in play? They said yes. That forces Dedicated or Private. BYOK KMS + VPC-only prewarmed instances. Can't use public-hosted burst that leaves customer VPC.
leo_finance: Commercially we can model three options: (1) larger baseline reserved to meet SLOs, (2) mid baseline + burst bank, (3) small baseline + large burst bank. Each has different blended unit economics. We can hit ~30% discount with option (1) or (2) depending on commit size.
jade_eng: Quick estimate: for 520 rps mixed, 99p <2s -> ~5-7 A100-class reserved for chat plus 2 as burst/prewarm; with int8 maybe 3-4 reserved. Embeddings on 2 x T4-style nodes.
mina_ml: We'll run perf sims. Need sample prompts and embedding payloads. We'll also produce quality regression checks for int8 fallback.
omar_sre: Autoscale policy suggestion: scale when GPU queue >55% for 45s, cooldown 90s, max burst +60% for 20m. Model-fallback: if request queue grows >200ms for >30s route 25% to quantized for 10m windows.
leo_finance: Customer asked about prepay burst credits and minute-level metering. We can support pre-funded burst bucket and roll unused credits month-to-month at a small credit. Will draft numbers.
tara_security: I need their DPA and list of subprocessors. Also confirm retention/erase requirements for transcripts. Private onboarding adds ~10 business days for audits.
deploy-bot: Load sim kicked: job ls-2026-5252. Results URL: https://internal.redwood/ls/ls-2026-5252
jade_eng: Action items: jade/mina run sims (48-72h), omar prepare autoscale and preheat runbook, tara start security checklist, leo model pricing scenarios, sam collect payloads and customer DPA.
sam_sales: Thanks team. I'll schedule a 30m review with the customer after sims post. :thumbsup:
